features:
Saw some dudes selling auto-farm scripts for 5 bucks on Discord. That's stupid expensive for something that takes like 5 minutes to code. 

That game's protection is trash anyway, so here's the same thing but free.

Auto EXP farming - Spams KillBonusExp remote
Auto money farming - Hits HighspeedFin for +100 each time
Speed controls - Adjust how fast it farms

A lot more should be possible based on features alone, but do it yourself, I don't want to. 

No keys - Because I'm not broke enough to need a key system

Go touch grass while it works
